added.added: The company is added. The mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
added.invited: The company is added and the invitation to the owner is sent. The mandate becomes active once they confirm it.
added.hasOwner: The company already has an owner in Fakturist — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
added.existing: The company is already in Fakturist without an owner. Your mandate waits for confirmation by Fakturist; the owner is invited by the firm that added it.

invite.ok: The invitation to the owner is sent.
invite.firmMember: This is an email of the firm’s employee — the invitation is for the company’s owner.
invite.rateLimited: The firm’s daily invitation limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
invite.hasOwner: The company already has an owner — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
invite.notFound: There is no active or pending mandate for this company.
invite.invalid: The invitation could not be sent.
invite.notCreator: The owner is invited by the firm that added the company to Fakturist. Your mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
invite.invited: Fakturist or another firm has already invited the owner — wait for their answer.
invite.locked: This company’s ownership was revoked in a dispute — only Fakturist invites a new owner.

org.limit: The free plan includes {limit} documents a month. Above that documents are still issued — consider a paid plan.
org.via: Access through an accounting firm's authorisation

doc.title: New document
doc.rateHelp: Only for a currency other than euro — for VAT in euro (Art. 114(5) of the VAT Act).
doc.linesHelp: Empty lines are skipped. Decimals with a dot or comma.
doc.issueHelp: The number is assigned on issue. An issued document cannot be edited — corrections are made with a note.
doc.problems: The document was not issued — please fix:

view.viaFirm: On behalf of the company, under the authorisation of
view.chain: Link no. {index} in the chain · fingerprint

client.title: New client company
client.help: The firm issues on behalf of the company under a written authorisation (Art. 113(7) of the VAT Act). The authorisation takes effect once the company's owner (if it has an account) or Fakturist confirms it after checking the document.
client.ownerEmailHelp: Optional. The owner gets an invitation and takes over ownership; with one tick they also confirm your mandate. Until then it waits.

errors.firmMember: This is an email of the firm’s employee — the invitation is for the company’s owner.
errors.rateLimited: The firm’s daily invitation limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.hasOwner: The company already has an owner — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
errors.notFound: There is no active or pending mandate for this company.
errors.invalid: The invitation could not be sent.
errors.notCreator: The owner is invited by the firm that added the company to Fakturist. Your mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
errors.invited: Fakturist or another firm has already invited the owner — wait for their answer.
errors.locked: This company’s ownership was revoked in a dispute — only Fakturist invites a new owner.

client.processorDeclaration: I declare that the client company has authorised the firm in writing to use Fakturist for its documents and that the firm has taken on the obligations of a processor under Art. 28(3) GDPR in its contract with the client.

security.title: Security
security.mustChange: Change your temporary password before you continue.
security.setup: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) or type the key in, then confirm with the six-digit code.
security.required: Two-factor sign-in is mandatory for the master account.

ok.password: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.help: Documents that companies registered with Fakturist issue to you (by EIK). They arrive automatically and an email with the PDF and XML goes to the owners, administrators and accountants.
inbox.verified: The sender is a company verified by Fakturist.
inbox.unverifiedHelp: The sender has not been verified by Fakturist yet — check the details and the account before you pay.
inbox.acceptHelp: The document is for us and the details are correct.

mandates.title: Authorisations
mandates.help: The accounting firms that issue on behalf of the company (Art. 113(7) of the VAT Act). A firm cannot issue until you confirm its authorisation.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.pdfIntro: The logo, font and layout of the PDF copy you send to your clients. The structured XML (UBL and CII) does not change.
settings.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 1 MB. It is re-encoded to at most 1200×600 pixels without metadata; SVG is not accepted.

classic.name: Classic
classic.help: White header, the number in the accent colour — closest to a paper invoice.

band.name: Band
band.help: A coloured band with the document type and number; the logo sits in a white box inside it.

compact.name: Compact
compact.help: Smaller type and narrower margins — more lines per page.

settings.fontHelp: Every font has Cyrillic, € and Bulgarian quotation marks.
settings.accentHelp: For the number, the band and the rule above “Amount due”. A colour that is too light is rejected — it must read on white (contrast at least 4.5:1).
settings.contentNote: The look changes appearance only. The VAT Act particulars, the amounts, the mandate and the Fakturist signature are in every look.

saved.pdf: The look is saved. It also applies to already issued documents the next time they are downloaded.

errors.invalidAccent: The colour is in the #rrggbb form.
errors.lowContrast: The colour is too light — choose a darker one.
errors.logoType: The logo is PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.logoCorrupt: The file cannot be read as an image.

catalog.noneParties: No contacts yet. Add the first one or save it when issuing a document.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.copyNote: The change applies to future documents — issued ones keep their data from the moment of issue.
catalog.seriesHelp: Each series is a continuous range of ten-digit numbers. A company's series never overlap; the issued part of a series cannot be cut.
catalog.startLockedHint: The series already has issued documents — its start cannot move and its end cannot drop below the last issued number.
catalog.newSeriesHint: The main series usually covers the whole range: first lower its end, then create the new one in the freed part.

errors.invalidEik: The EIK is invalid — 9 or 13 digits with a correct check digit.
errors.vatMismatch: A Bulgarian VAT number is BG + the same contact's EIK.
errors.invalidCountry: The country is a two-letter code (BG, DE, IT…).
errors.invalidPrice: The price is a number with up to 6 decimals.
errors.invalidRate: The rate is a number (e.g. 20 or 9).
errors.rateCategory: Category S has a rate above 0; the other categories have rate 0.
errors.invalidRange: The start is after the end.
errors.nameTaken: A series with this name exists.
errors.overlap: The range overlaps another series of the company.
errors.startLocked: The start of a series with issued documents cannot move.
errors.issuedBelow: The end cannot drop below the last issued number.
errors.inUse: A series with issued documents cannot be deleted.
errors.isDefault: The default series cannot be deleted — choose another one first.

catalog.saveBuyer: Save the recipient as a contact

members.title: Members
members.inviteHelp: The invitation is an email link valid for 7 days. The role is below yours; the owner is not invited — ownership comes by transfer.

err.invalid: Check the email and the role.
err.forbiddenRole: You cannot give or change this role.
err.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of the company.
err.rateLimited: Too many invitations today — try tomorrow.
err.self: You cannot change your own role.

annul.button: Annul and issue a new one
annul.title: Annulment under Art. 116 of the VAT Act
annul.lead: You are annulling document no. {number} of {date}. The document you are issuing now replaces it — both happen in one step. The annulled number stays taken.
annul.hint: Only for an incorrectly drawn up document. A discount, return or cancelled supply is corrected with a credit or debit note (Art. 115 of the VAT Act).

reasons.vatMissing: VAT not charged when it should have been (para. 2)
reasons.vatCharged: VAT charged when it should not have been (para. 3)
